text: Over the last 30 days, visitor reviews have highlighted issues with the quality and flavor of the food at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Two reviews specifically mentioned salads and other menu items as lacking flavor or having awkward combinations. One review noted the menu includes healthy options but suggested the recipes need improvement. Overall, the average rating was low, indicating dissatisfaction primarily related to food quality.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several comments mention bland or poorly balanced dishes, with specific criticism of salads and the venison chili. There are also concerns about the limited menu range and the absence of basic service items like cups for water. One review pointed out that the food is overpriced relative to the portion size. Overall, the average rating is low, reflecting dissatisfaction primarily focused on dining.
windows.90: Over the last 90 days, several visitors have expressed dissatisfaction with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Common concerns include bland or poorly prepared dishes, limited variety, and some items not matching their descriptions. A few reviewers also noted issues with service, such as the lack of water cups and overall value for the price. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the food offerings and related service aspects appear to need improvement.
